# Vylos Media

> Vylos Media is a video production company based in Carlsbad, California, founded by Charlie Marinelli, serving businesses across North County San Diego. It films, directs, edits and color grades short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and promo and ad videos.

- Location: Carlsbad, CA. Films on location across North County San Diego: Carlsbad, Oceanside, Encinitas, San Marcos, Vista, Escondido, Solana Beach, Del Mar, Poway and Fallbrook.
- Services: filming and direction, video editing, color grading, Reels and TikToks, promo and ad videos. Full production from idea to final cut.
- Pricing: custom quotes based on video length, number of videos and whether filming is on location. The first Reel is free for new clients.
- Contact: charlie@vylosmedia.com · Instagram @vylosmedia · https://vylosmedia.com/#contact
